scope: Replace mandatory two-administrator import approval with a direct Upload, Preview and fix, Results workflow while retaining authenticated ownership, draft integrity, idempotency, atomic PostgreSQL storage, typed readback verification, automatic rollback, and the emergency import switch.

evidence: framework/design-change-requests/DCR-2026-007-simple-import-workflow.md records the approved product and design change.
operations/Test-DesignLock.ps1 verifies the approved request and the updated locked stylesheet.
backend/src/imports.ts requires import.execute and the authenticated session owner for direct imports.
The commit contract still checks the current draft revision, hash, and idempotency key under a database lock.
backend/test/importWorkflow.test.ts verifies typed PostgreSQL readback, including canonical date equality.
All 109 backend tests passed locally for candidate 1.4.1.
database/Migrations/010-simplified-import-workflow.sql is transactional, advisory-locked, ordered after migration 009, and uniquely journaled.
database/Test-DatabaseContract.sql requires migration 010 and the enabled direct-import runtime state.
CSV and XLSX uploads remain persistent resumable sessions with source metadata, mappings, rows, issues, revision, hash, and results.
frontend/src/pages/ImportPage.test.tsx verifies resuming a saved session from its URL.
backend/test/importSources.test.ts covers CSV encodings and delimiters, XLSX worksheets, formula rejection, 1,000 rows, and the 10 MB limit.
Equivalent CSV and XLSX fixtures continue to produce the same canonical parsed draft.
frontend/src/pages/ImportPage.tsx presents Upload, Preview and fix, and Results without approval controls.
All 46 frontend tests passed locally, including direct import, disabled-mode preview retention, row correction, and completion refresh.
backend/src/imports.ts requires READY with zero invalid rows and no longer queries import_reviews during commit.
The same endpoint retains transaction locking, revision/hash checks, idempotency, complete rollback, and field-aware readback verification.
The completion response still refreshes Search, Inventory, Reports, Activity, imports, and categories.
The Results stage links to imported assets and offers Import another file.
operations/Build-Delta-Package.ps1 and operations/Test-Delta-Package.ps1 require migration 010 and contract 010-simplified-import-workflow.
The updater retains package hash, source-version, migration, component-manifest, and post-publish health checks.
Candidate 1.4.1 passes backend and frontend TypeScript checks.
The release updater verifies direct API, IIS API, published web version, PostgreSQL readiness, and every application route.
